comments.P: Correct enquire-first hierarchy and brand chalk/ink/coral, but composition is a thin left-object/right-type axis, signature is only a selector name, plates stay diagram-led, and unknowns are undeclared.
comments.Q: Portfolio Grid + Neo Brutalism with Space Grotesk and pink/cyan system accents fights coastal letterpress evidence; editions, Heidelberg facts, and enquire journey are barely bound — generic creative portfolio retrieval.
comments.R: Ferry departures board turns Harbour Night / Chalk Path / Ferry Board into instrument rows with coral registration lamp and view→facts→enquire columns — strongest distinctive direction; implementability dips only if board becomes empty transit UI without real edition facts.
comments.S: Locked platen chase + job-ticket rail + coral registration cross is print-native end-to-end: hex tokens, three type roles, honest Ferry Board pending, density-4 chalk space, motion-3 settle — best grounded ship package.
comments.T: Solid press-room asymmetric portfolio with three edition slots and coral registration motif; fully anti-cliché and honest on needed assets, but less instrument-specific than chase or departures board.
